decisions.title: What Phase 0B is for, and when to commit
decisions.recommendation: Fund 0A. Hold 0B as a gated real option, sized at the gate by signed Phase 1 demand. Call Phase 0 a capability programme, not a cost saving.

decisions.title: Gate structure and stringency; use of TRL
decisions.recommendation: Hybrid: NASA life-cycle gates with TRL/AD² for each critical technology, plus four discriminating gates (target, demand, economics, licence). Stringency follows reversibility.

decisions.title: Escaped-debris and containment limit
decisions.recommendation: Set an ALARP requirement with an interim design ceiling. The number itself goes to modelling, tests and the licensing state.

decisions.title: Where Phase 0 delivers its product
decisions.recommendation: Use SEL1 as the reference case. Re-decide jointly with Phase 1 at the 0B gate.

decisions.title: Tug propellant; water-EP track
decisions.recommendation: Select no propellant yet. Cost iodine as the reference case and argon as the alternate, pending the supply audit and life tests. Water EP stays a desk study until a C-type target is confirmed.

gateRulings.question: rq-0-68
gateRulings.ruling: "Within 3×" in the demand gate is a quantity ratio (capacity against signed demand), not a timing tolerance.

gateRulings.question: rq-0-68
gateRulings.ruling: "Signed" demand means specified, financially backed commitments; technical endorsements and planning allowances do not count.

gateRulings.question: rq-0-70
gateRulings.ruling: After a failed licence gate, at most one bounded redesign and reapplication for a remediable failure, with gate requirements unchanged, no production authorisation meanwhile, and the 0A-only fallback retained.

gateRulings.question: rq-0-74
gateRulings.ruling: TRL 4-5 may release reversible 0A funding tranches. A scout or pathfinder PDR is a separate gate requiring TRL 6 for flight-critical technology.
stillOpen: readiness of technologies flown as experiments

gateRulings.question: rq-0-73
gateRulings.ruling: T11 (rendezvous scouts) and T18 (sampling and assay) at TRL 6 at scout PDR.

gateRulings.question: rq-0-69
gateRulings.ruling: The month-180 sunset acts automatically; it is not only a prompt for review.

gateRulings.question: rq-0-67
gateRulings.ruling: Any cost above Earth supply needs a separate, explicit owner authorisation; D-01's purpose does not authorise a premium by itself.

gateRulings.question: rq-0-66
gateRulings.ruling: No blanket duplicate TRL 6 demonstration for T11, T18, T09, T12 and T20 at KDP-0B; applicable 0A evidence is reused.
